sentence: This project tests whether blocking an enzyme can stop multiple myeloma from coming back through cancer stem-like cells and make chemotherapy work better.
This project builds and tests a practical way to make quantitative whole-body PET images of children without making scans longer.
This project studies how enterococci change the gut environment and affect how well and how harmfully Clostridioides difficile causes infection.
This project builds a three-dimensional cell culture platform that can be screened automatically to target a cancer signaling pathway in pediatric brain tumors.
This project builds an online database that uses machine learning to model nanomaterials and guide the design of nanomedicines.
This project provides quantitative methods, including statistical modeling and machine learning, to study human movement variability and help treat and prevent motor-related disorders.
This project studies how a tumor suppressor protein controls gene expression in kidney cancer, aiming to find targets for treatment.
This project tries to find out how cells make and control a protein that protects cancer cells from ferroptosis, a form of cell death.
This project builds genomics and bioinformatics services, from sequencing to data analysis, that help researchers study eukaryotic pathogens.
This project tests whether small RNA drugs can silence the causes of ischemia-reperfusion injury in donor livers during transplantation.
This project strengthens a veterinary diagnostic laboratory so it can do sequencing and diagnostic testing that supports the national food safety system.
This project studies what P-bodies do in tissue regeneration, since they control how mRNA is used and how genes are expressed.
This project studies how human odors change olfactory cells in healthy and diseased people, using biopsies and single cell assays.
This project builds single cell methods to find the molecular mechanisms that decide how a viral infection turns out in each cell.
This project uses polygenic risk scoring and machine learning on images to find genes that may work together to raise cardiovascular disease risk.
This project develops a one-time gene therapy that lowers the prion protein in the brain, to protect against prion disease.
This project tests whether popular botanical dietary supplements contain molecules like progesterone that switch on the progesterone receptor.
This project studies how a protein controls mitochondrial dynamics and brown fat heat production, which may help treat obesity and type 2 diabetes.
This project records brain-wide electrical networks in rodent parents to learn how the brain changes to guide parental care behavior.
This project builds a system that uses nanopore analysis of DNA markers in blood to measure how much radiation a person absorbed.
